hero.title: Invoicing for Czech and Slovak businesses, without the paperwork

features.title: Everything you need to invoice, in one place

isdoc.title: ISDOC export

aiVoice.title: Invoice from a voice message

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: This page summarizes what the Terms of Service (VOP) will cover. It is a structural overview, not binding legal text — the actual wording is still being drafted by an attorney with e-commerce/SaaS experience.

asIs.title: "As-is" disclaimer
asIs.summary: This section will state that the software is provided as-is, without warranty of fitness for a particular purpose and without any guarantee that its output complies with current or future tax legislation.

noAdvice.title: Not tax or legal advice
noAdvice.summary: This section will clarify that Faktur is a document-generation and automation tool, not a tax advisor or accountant, and that nothing in the product constitutes tax or legal advice.

userResponsibility.title: User responsibility for invoice content
userResponsibility.summary: This section will state that the issuing tenant is solely responsible for verifying all invoice data — amounts, VAT rates, counterparty details, and due dates — before issuing.

aiDisclaimer.title: AI-drafted invoice disclaimer
aiDisclaimer.summary: This section will explain that voice-transcribed, AI-extracted invoice data is always a draft requiring human review, and that clicking "Issue" is the point at which the user assumes full responsibility for its content.

aresDisclaimer.title: ARES registry data disclaimer
aresDisclaimer.summary: This section will state that counterparty data is fetched as-is from the public ARES registry and that the platform does not guarantee its accuracy or currency.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.summary: This section will limit or exclude liability for indirect damages — fines, penalties, tax reassessments — arising from invoice content, to the extent permitted under Czech law.

governingLaw.title: Governing law & jurisdiction
governingLaw.summary: This section will state that the contractual relationship is governed by Czech law and that disputes are resolved in Czech courts.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page summarizes what the privacy policy will cover. It is a structural overview, not binding legal text — the actual wording is still being prepared by an attorney specializing in data protection.

dataCollected.title: What data we collect
dataCollected.summary: This section will list the data we collect — tenant account and company details, contact details of counterparties, and the content of issued invoices.

purpose.title: Why we process it
purpose.summary: This section will explain that data is processed to deliver the service and to meet the legal obligation to retain accounting records for roughly 10 years.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.summary: This section will name the processors we share data with — Stripe and GoPay for subscription billing, OpenAI for voice-message transcription when the AI feature is used, and the public ARES registry when verifying counterparty details.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.summary: This section will describe the right to access, export, and delete personal data, subject to the legal retention carve-out for accounting records.

dataResidency.title: Where data is stored
dataResidency.summary: This section will confirm that data is hosted within the EU and does not move outside the European legal framework.

about.title: About Faktur
about.lead: Faktur is an invoicing tool built on top of the open standards that already run Czech and Slovak invoicing — not around them.
about.whatBody: Faktur issues invoices in the ISDOC format, pulls counterparty details straight from the ARES business registry, and keeps your numbering sequence and VAT rates consistent, so you're not stuck copying last month's spreadsheet template. You can also send a voice note over Telegram or WhatsApp and Faktur will turn it into a draft invoice ready for a quick check — it's only final once you confirm it yourself.
about.whoBody: We're building this for freelancers and small businesses in Czech Republic and Slovakia — people who invoice themselves between client meetings, not a finance department with its own IT staff.
about.whyBody: Invoicing always took us longer than it should have — looking up a company ID in ARES, tracking the next invoice number by hand, opening a laptop just to bill one line item on the way back from a client. We wanted something that handles that part and leaves us to decide only what actually matters: whether the invoice is right before it goes out.
